auto_col_widths(col_header = ...) includes header text in width
auto_col_widths(min_col_width_twips = N) enforces a floor
auto_col_widths(protect_cols=) keeps a column at natural width when shrinking
auto_col_widths(table_width_twips = N) scales to sum exactly N
text_width_in() accepts arial / courier_new / courier
text_width_in() falls back to Courier on unknown font
text_width_in() returns a numeric the same length as input
text_width_in() scales linearly with character count (Courier)
text_width_in() scales with size_half_points (larger size -> wider)
text_width_in() treats NA as empty string (width 0)
